ei.subject: 공통영어1
ei.title: Getting Off to a Good Start

fullPassage:
High school is the best time to spark your curiosity and passion. You can explore, try new things, and learn more about yourself. The three years pass quickly, so use this time wisely to set yourself up for the future. Here are a few ways to do just that.
Making time for exercise with a busy schedule is not easy. However, it's important to exercise regularly because it offers countless benefits. You can have more new experiences and complete more challenging tasks with increased energy. The benefits are not limited to physical strength; exercise also boosts confidence and fosters a positive attitude. Whether you like lifting weights at the gym, jogging through the park, or riding a bicycle, establishing and sticking to an exercise routine will strengthen your body, mind, and spirit.
Choosing your career path is one of the most important decisions you can make, and having a role model can be a powerful tool for making your dreams come true. Looking into the lives of the people you admire can be an inspiration in itself. Your role model can be someone you know personally, such as a teacher or family member, or someone you admire, such as a famous athlete or artist. If you pick someone in your social circle, you can directly ask for their guidance. If it is someone you can't meet in person, you can study their actions and observe their strategies. What you learn from them will benefit you both during and long after high school.
These days, many teenagers spend too much time staring at smartphones and computer screens. Some even stay up late playing computer games and watching videos. This is fine as long as these devices enrich your life. However, excessive reliance on technology can exhaust your mental energy. To make it easier to focus on important things, set aside your devices for some time. For example, it's a good idea to finish surfing the Internet, watching videos, and sending instant messages during the week and turn everything off on the weekends. You can use your newly found time to connect with friends, family, and yourself. You might be surprised at how much more productive you can be when not glued to a screen.
Who you are now says a lot about who you'll be in the future. However, as the years pass, some of your current interests and perspectives may fade. You could try sending a note to your future self. Writing a letter to your future self will allow you to take a moment to reflect on where you are, where you're heading, and what's important to you right now. Furthermore, when you're older, this letter can serve as a reminder of the person you used to be. It might even give you a new sense of strength to live a more meaningful life.
The high school years can be overwhelming at times, but the challenge is there for a reason, and you don't have to be perfect every step of the way. During your high school days, have a great time trying out different things and discovering what works best for you. More importantly, however, don't forget to have fun along the way!

questions.passage: High school is the best time to spark your curiosity and passion. You can explore, try new things, and learn more about yourself. However, it's important ④<u>to exercise</u> regularly because it offers countless benefits.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 운동 루틴을 만들고 고수하는 것(sticking)이 몸을 강화한다.
det.analysis: ❌ ①stick: Establishing과 병렬 → sticking 필요. ✅ ②pass: 주어 years(복수) 일치. ✅ ③set: 원형부정사(to set) 정상. ✅ ④to exercise: It is important to V 정상.
det.tip: 병렬 구조: Establishing and sticking to. 둘 다 동명사.

questions.passage: These days, many teenagers spend too much time ①<u>staring</u> at smartphones and computer screens. You might be surprised at how much more productive you can be when not ②<u>glue</u> to a screen. This is fine as long as these devices ③<u>enrich</u> your life. To make it ④<u>easier</u> to focus on important things, set aside your devices for some time.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 화면에 붙어있지(glued) 않으면 더 생산적이다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①staring: spend time + V-ing 정상. ❌ ②glue: 수동 의미(화면에 붙어있는 상태)이므로 glued 필요. ✅ ③enrich: 주어 devices(복수) 일치. ✅ ④easier: make it + 비교급 형용사 정상.
det.tip: be glued to: ~에 붙어있다. 수동태. glue(능동) → glued(수동).

questions.passage: Who you are now says a lot about who you'll be in the future. Writing a letter to your future self will ①<u>allow</u> you to take a moment to reflect on where you are. Furthermore, when you're older, this letter can serve ②<u>as</u> a reminder. It might even give you a new sense of strength to live a ③<u>most</u> meaningful life. However, as the years pass, some of your current interests and perspectives may ④<u>fade</u>.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: 더 의미 있는(more meaningful) 삶을 살 힘을 줄 수 있다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①allow: allow + O + to V 정상. ✅ ②as: serve as ~ 정상. ❌ ③most: 비교급 문맥. 'a more meaningful life'가 원문. 부정관사 a + 비교급 → more. ✅ ④fade: 자동사, may + 원형 정상.
det.tip: more meaningful(비교급) vs most meaningful(최상급). 부정관사 a + 비교급 → a more meaningful.

questions.passage: Making time for exercise with a busy schedule is not easy. However, it's important to exercise regularly because it offers countless benefits. You can have more new experiences and complete more ①<u>challenging</u> tasks with increased energy. Establishing and sticking to an exercise routine will strengthen your body, mind, and ②<u>doubt</u>. The benefits are not limited to physical ③<u>strength</u>; exercise also boosts confidence and ④<u>fosters</u> a positive attitude.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 운동 루틴은 몸, 마음, 정신(spirit)을 강화한다. doubt(의심)는 부적절.
det.analysis: ✅ ①challenging(도전적인): 원문 그대로. ❌ ②doubt(의심): 원문은 spirit(정신). body, mind, spirit의 긍정적 병렬. ✅ ③strength(힘): 원문 그대로. ✅ ④fosters(기르다): 원문 그대로.
det.tip: spirit(정신) ↔ doubt(의심). 운동이 강화하는 3가지: 몸, 마음, 정신.

questions.passage: Choosing your career path is one of the most important decisions you can make, and having a role model can be a powerful tool for making your dreams come true. Looking into the lives of the people you ①<u>admire</u> can be an inspiration in itself. Your role model can be someone you know ②<u>personally</u>. If it is someone you can't meet in person, you can study their actions and ③<u>overlook</u> their strategies. What you learn from them will ④<u>benefit</u> you both during and long after high school.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 단어 중, 문맥상 부적절한 것은?

det.korean: 직접 만날 수 없으면 행동을 연구하고 전략을 관찰(observe)할 수 있다. overlook(간과하다)는 반대 의미.
det.analysis: ✅ ①admire(존경하다): 원문 그대로. ✅ ②personally(개인적으로): 원문 그대로. ❌ ③overlook(간과하다): 원문은 observe(관찰하다). 전략을 '간과'하면 배울 수 없음. ✅ ④benefit(도움이 되다): 원문 그대로.
det.tip: observe(관찰하다) ↔ overlook(간과하다). 비슷해 보이지만 반대 의미.

questions.passage: Making time for exercise with a busy schedule is not easy. However, it's important to exercise regularly because it offers countless benefits. You can have more new experiences and complete more challenging tasks with increased energy. The benefits are not limited to physical strength; exercise also boosts __________ and fosters a positive attitude.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 운동은 자신감을 높이고 긍정적 태도를 기른다.
det.analysis: ✅ ①confidence(자신감): 운동의 이점으로 자신감 향상. ❌ ②isolation(고립): 부정적. ❌ ③confusion(혼란): 부정적. ❌ ④hostility(적대감): 부정적.
det.tip: boosts confidence: 자신감을 높이다. 운동의 긍정적 효과 맥락.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 화면에 붙어있지 않으면 얼마나 더 생산적인지 놀랄 것이다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③productive(생산적인): 기기에서 벗어남 → 생산성 향상. ❌ ①dependent(의존적인): 기기 의존을 줄이는 맥락에서 반대. ❌ ②isolated(고립된): 친구와 연결하는 맥락과 반대. ❌ ④exhausted(지친): 에너지를 절약하는 맥락에서 부적절.
det.tip: productive: 생산적인. 기기 의존 ↓ → 집중력 ↑ → 생산성 ↑.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 고등학교는 호기심과 열정에 불을 붙일 최적의 시기이다.
미래를 위한 준비는 대학에서 시작해야 한다.

det.korean: 고등학교는 호기심과 열정에 불을 붙일 최적의 시기라고 했다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②: 원문 'the best time to spark your curiosity and passion'과 일치. ❌ ①: 'pass quickly'이므로 '빨리 지나간다'. ❌ ③: 대학이 아닌 고등학교에서 준비. ❌ ④: 위험하다는 언급 없음.
det.tip: the best time: 최적의 시기. spark: 불을 붙이다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?
ch: 바쁜 일정에서 운동 시간을 만드는 것은 쉽다.
운동의 이점은 오직 체력 향상에 국한된다.
에너지가 줄어들면 도전적 과제를 완수할 수 있다.
운동은 자신감을 높이고 긍정적 태도를 길러준다.

det.korean: 운동은 자신감을 높이고 긍정적 태도를 기른다.
det.analysis: ✅ ④: 원문 'boosts confidence and fosters a positive attitude'와 일치. ❌ ①: 'not easy'이므로 쉽지 않다. ❌ ②: 'not limited to physical strength'. ❌ ③: 'increased energy'(증가된 에너지)가 맞음.
det.tip: boosts confidence: 자신감을 높이다. fosters a positive attitude: 긍정적 태도를 기르다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?
ch: 진로 선택은 가장 중요한 결정 중 하나이다.
존경하는 사람들의 삶을 들여다보는 것은 영감이 된다.
롤 모델은 반드시 유명한 사람이어야 한다.
사회적 인맥의 누군가에게 직접 조언을 구할 수 있다.

det.korean: 롤 모델은 개인적으로 아는 사람(선생님, 가족) 또는 유명인일 수 있으므로 반드시 유명인이어야 한다는 것은 불일치.
det.analysis: ✅ ③불일치: 'someone you know personally'도 롤 모델이 될 수 있다. ❌ ①: 원문과 일치. ❌ ②: 'an inspiration in itself'와 일치. ❌ ④: 'directly ask for their guidance'와 일치.
det.tip: or: 두 가지 선택지 제시. 유명인 OR 개인적으로 아는 사람.

questions.passage: Who you are now says a lot about who you'll be in the future. However, as the years pass, some of your current interests and perspectives may fade. You could try sending a note to your future self. Writing a letter to your future self will allow you to take a moment to reflect on where you are, where you're heading, and what's important to you right now. Furthermore, when you're older, this letter can serve as a reminder of the person you used to be.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 미래의 자신에게 편지를 쓰는 것의 가치

det.korean: 미래의 자신에게 편지를 써서 성찰하고 상기하는 것의 가치.
det.analysis: ✅ ①: 편지 쓰기의 가치(성찰, 상기, 힘) 전달. ❌ ②: 관심사를 '포기'하라는 내용 아님. ❌ ③: 성격 변화 원인은 언급 없음. ❌ ④: 과학적 예측과 무관.
det.tip: 주제 = 글 전체 핵심. 편지 → 성찰 + 상기 + 의미 있는 삶.

questions.passage: The high school years can be overwhelming at times, but the challenge is there for a reason, and you don't have to be perfect every step of the way. During your high school days, have a great time trying out different things and discovering what works best for you. More importantly, however, don't forget to have fun along the way!
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 "the challenge is there for a reason"이 의미하는 바로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: 고등학교의 도전은 대학 입시를 위한 것이다.
도전은 우연히 생기는 것으로 의미가 없다.

det.korean: 도전에는 이유가 있다 = 어려움이 성장의 목적을 가진다는 뜻.
det.analysis: ✅ ②: 'for a reason(이유가 있어서)' → 성장과 발견을 위한 과정. ❌ ①: '피해야 할'이 아닌 '받아들여야 할'. ❌ ③: 입시 한정이 아닌 포괄적 성장. ❌ ④: 'for a reason'은 의미가 있다는 뜻.
det.tip: for a reason: 이유가 있어서. 도전 → 성장의 과정.

questions.passage: Choosing your career path is one of the most important decisions you can make, and having a role model can be a powerful tool for making your dreams come true. Looking into the lives of the people you admire can be an inspiration in itself. Your role model can be someone you know personally, such as a teacher or family member. If you pick someone in your social circle, you can directly ask for their guidance. If it is someone you can't meet in person, you can study <u>their</u> actions and observe their strategies.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>their</u>이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?
ch: the role model you can't meet in person

det.korean: 직접 만날 수 없는 롤 모델의 행동을 연구한다.
det.analysis: ✅ ③: 'someone you can't meet in person'을 받는 소유격 their. ❌ ①: dreams에는 actions이 없음. ❌ ②: social circle은 장소 개념. ❌ ④: 이전 문장의 social circle이 아닌 직접 못 만나는 사람.
det.tip: their = someone you can't meet in person. 대명사는 가장 가까운 선행사를 참조.

questions.passage: Who you are now says a lot about who you'll be in the future. However, as the years pass, some of your current interests and perspectives may fade. You could try sending a note to your future self. Writing a letter to your future self will allow you to take a moment to reflect on where you are, where you're heading, and what's important to you right now. Furthermore, when you're older, <u>this letter</u> can serve as a reminder of the person you used to be.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 <u>this letter</u>이 가리키는 것으로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 미래의 자신에게 쓴 편지. 앞 문장 'Writing a letter to your future self'를 가리킨다.
det.analysis: ✅ ②: 'a letter to your future self'를 this letter로 지칭. ❌ ①: 과거에 받은 편지가 아님. ❌ ③: 추천서 언급 없음. ❌ ④: 친구가 아닌 미래의 자신.
det.tip: this letter = a letter to your future self. this는 앞에서 언급된 것을 가리킴.

questions.passage: These days, many teenagers spend too much time staring at smartphones and computer screens. Some even stay up late playing computer games and watching videos. This is fine as long as these devices enrich your life. However, excessive reliance on technology can exhaust your mental energy. To make it easier to focus on important things, set aside your devices for some time. For example, it's a good idea to finish surfing the Internet, watching videos, and sending instant messages during the week and turn everything off on the weekends. You can use your newly found time to connect with friends, family, and yourself. You might be surprised at how much more productive you can be when not glued to a screen.
questions.stem: 다음 글에서 '과도한 기술 의존이 정신적 에너지를 고갈시키다'에 해당하는 영어 표현의 핵심 동사를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.

det.korean: 과도한 기술 의존이 정신적 에너지를 고갈시키다(exhaust).
det.analysis: exhaust: 고갈시키다, 소진시키다. 'exhaust your mental energy'에서 핵심 동사.
det.tip: exhaust: 1) 고갈시키다 2) 지치게 하다. 여기서는 에너지를 '소진'시키는 의미.

questions.passage: Writing a letter to your future self will allow you to take a moment to reflect on where you are, where you're heading, and what's important to you right now. Furthermore, when you're older, this letter can serve as a [reminder] of the person you used to be. It might even give you a new sense of strength to live a more meaningful life.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 변형하여 쓰시오.

det.korean: 이 편지가 과거의 자신을 상기시키는 것(reminder)이 될 수 있다.
det.analysis: remind → reminder. 관사 a 뒤, 전치사 of 앞이므로 명사 reminder.
det.tip: remind(동사) → reminder(명사). 'serve as a reminder' = 상기시키는 역할을 하다.
